title: A. Tanaka
summary: A. Tanaka served as a stock counter for Count Team 3 in Aisle B during the Manchester Main Stores 2023 annual count.
body:
A. Tanaka was a stock counter at Manchester Main Stores during the 2023 annual inventory verification [^r1]. Tanaka operated in Count Team 3 covering Aisle B under the annual stock counting procedures [^r1]. Records from the count sheet document Tanaka's participation on site [^r1].

## Stock count activity

On 25 March 2023, A. Tanaka served as a stock counter for Count Team 3 in Aisle B during the Annual Stock Count at Manchester Main Stores [^r1].
